findings.note: ESPN shows Sennecke with 25 shots in 9 October games (about 2.8 per game) at 20:59 TOI. His recent game log of 3, 4, 1, 4 and 2 shots means he got 3+ shots in three of his last five games, which goes against the Under 2.5.

The NHL.com projected lineup for today's game puts Sennecke on the second line with Nikita Nesterenko and Mikael Granlund, with Carlsson and Gauthier on the top line. No injury to him is flagged, so he is expected to play his usual top-six role.

Rotowire notes say Sennecke is playing top-six minutes with first-unit power-play time this season, which points to more shots. Last season he had 191 shots in 79 games (about 2.4 per game), a rate below the 2.5 line that leans toward the Under.
